description: CD registry — the repos this hub is allowed to MERGE and DEPLOY. A workflow on a repo listed here runs the full ship phase (release manager reviews the final PR, a human approves the merge, the RM merges + deploys through `pipeline` via the Pipeline___* tools, or per the repo's DEPLOY.md when no pipeline is named). A workflow on any OTHER repo is a HANDOFF: it ends once review, QA and CI are done, the orchestrator opens the unified PR and leaves it OPEN for the owning team. This checked-in file only SEEDS s3://<ARTIFACT_BUCKET>/config/cd-registry.json on first deploy; the live registry is edited in the Workflow tab (Target Repository → CD registry) or with scripts/cd-registry.sh — never by re-copying this file. Entry shape: { "repo": "owner/repo", "pipeline": "<CodePipeline name>", "region": "us-east-1", "ciProject": "<CodeBuild PR-check project name>", "deployDoc": "DEPLOY.md", "account": "<12-digit account, cross-account CD only>", "roleArn": "arn:aws:iam::<account>:role/hub-cd-trigger-<slug>", "externalId": "<STS ExternalId>", "notes": "..." } — only `repo` is required. `ciProject` is a CodeBuild PROJECT, NOT a CodePipeline: the PR-check project the CI agent reads through the Pipeline___* tools (defaults to `agentcore-hub-ci`). The cross-account triple (`account`/`roleArn`/`externalId`) is optional and points CD at a pipeline in ANOTHER AWS account; it is honored only as a complete, valid set (roleArn must name a `hub-cd-trigger-*` role in `account`), which the Pipeline___* tools Lambda reaches by assuming that trigger-only role.
